messages.author: ce4dca87de559c5c
messages.subject: gheatmap heatmap matrix data type
parts:
Hello everyone,

Does the gheatmap function only support matrices with categorical data?
I've been trying to use the function with a numerical matrix (making sure the row names coincide with the tree's tip labels) and get the following error:

> gheatmap(p1, mat_data, offset = 2, width=0.5) 
Error: is.character(x) is not TRUE
In addition: Warning message:
In gheatmap(p1, mat_data, offset = 2, width = 0.5) : Coercing LHS to a list


Is there a way around this?

Kind regards,
Maria

messages.subject: Re: gheatmap heatmap matrix data type
parts:
Hello,

Thanks for your prompt reply. Find attached the input data, and my R script below.

setwd("~/Desktop")
data<-read.csv("mat_data.csv") #read mat_data file from Desktop
rownames_mat<- data[,1]
mat_data<- as.matrix(data[,-1])
rownames(mat_data)<-rownames_mat

tree<- read.tree("myco_newick.nwk") #read newick file from Desktop
p1<- ggtree(tree, color="firebrick", size=1, linetype="dotted")
p1
gheatmap(p1, mat_data, offset = 2, width=0.5) #append tree to heatmap

Kind regards,
Maria
